items.title: Ben Kelly Interview, 1960-08-11
items.q: In Markton's Sun. He'd do that in the daytime and play music at night.

ctx.x: Used to wake up in the Iron Yard up there on the Capitol between St. Gene and Market, 1662, 66. Oh, the Iron Yard. Yeah. In Markton's Sun. He'd do that in the daytime and play music at night. Yeah. Yeah.

Yeah. Yeah. Very good. Did you ever go to hear his band play? Yeah, plenty of time I was there with him. Yeah? He had played with my artists where I was blowing things. You remember, you know, we all talk at the Bulls Club? Oh yeah. Oh yeah. Still the Yard's Club uptown now. Yeah.
